newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia's Rijecka Banka wins debut foreign loan.
newsitem.headline: Croatia's Rijecka Banka wins debut foreign loan.

text.p: Croatia's Rijecka Banka, which recently completed rehabilitation under a government programme, said on Thursday foreign creditors had granted it a 25 million mark loan, its first international syndicated loan.
"It is a long-term syndicated loan under very favourable terms," bank official Ornela Vuskovic Kosier told Reuters, but declined to specify the interest rate.

Repayment is over a period of six years, including one-year grace, she said and added: "The funds will be used to expand our customer base and increase financial support to prime clients in the region."
The bank is based in Rijeka port on the northern Adriatic coast. This is its first time it has borrowed on the international commercial loan market.

The credit was arranged by Germany's Bayerische Landesbank Girozentrale in a syndicate with the Hungarian Bank for Foreign Trade (MKB), Vienna-based Bank fuer Arbeit und Wirtschaft AG and Landesbank Schleswig Holstein Int. S.A. from Luxembourg.
The loan agreement will be signed in Munich on June 2. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
